title: Bert Williams' song Don't Help That Bear
summary: Green recounts Williams' comic song about a hunter chased by a grizzly bear, which he saw in the Ziegfeld Follies with Will Rogers.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yes. Well, the Bert Williams song, "Don't Help That Bear", is about -- there's a big hunter. He's famous for being a great hunter. He was out in some strange woods and of course he took his gun along. And he had been out there for the better part of the morning and the rest of the day, and when it was getting darkness started approaching in the sky, he was just about to turn in and head for home, and just as he went to turn around to head for home, there was a great big grizzly bear standing directly behind him. (Laughing) And he was on twos. So he didn't take his gun no further. He threw the gun up in the sky, and then he tried to fly. He was trying to go around the bear any way he can. And he finally got loose, and the bear started to follow him. The faster he'd run the faster the bear would run. So he'd say, "I can't keep this up much further. I'm going to lose my hair." Said, "I think I'm going to climb that great big tall oak tree, and when I get up there (Unintelligible). Well, that's a bit of it, but he had music going on with the song.
Please Lord, don't help that bear.
Where did you see him perform?
Oh, in the Ziegfeld Follies. He was
starring in the Ziegfeld Follies for Florenz Ziegfeld. Naturally his buddy, And Will Rogers, was right along with him.
